name: Kopia Backups
template: <Stack gap="sm" p="sm"><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap"><Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap"><Image src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons/svg/kopia.svg" w={28} h={28} /><Stack gap={0}><Text fw={700} size="md">Kopia Backups</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{(data.sources?.localUsername ?? "?") + "@" + (data.sources?.localHost ?? "?")}</Text></Stack></Group><RefreshButton /></Group>{status.sources?.loading || status.repo?.loading ? <Skeleton height={220} radius="md" /> : status.sources?.error ? <Alert color="red">{status.sources.error}</Alert> : status.repo?.error ? <Alert color="red">{status.repo.error}</Alert> : <><Group justify="space-between"><Badge color={data.repo?.connected ? "green" : "red"} variant="light" size="md" radius="sm">{data.repo?.connected ? "● CONNECTED" : "● OFFLINE"}</Badge><Badge color="blue" variant="light" size="md" radius="sm">{(data.sources?.sources?.length ?? 0) + " Quellen"}</Badge></Group>{(data.sources?.sources?.length ?? 0) === 0 ? <Text ta="center" c="dimmed" size="sm">Keine Backup-Quellen</Text> : <Stack gap="xs">{data.sources.sources.map((item) => <Card key={item.source.host + item.source.userName + item.source.path} withBorder radius="md" padding="sm" shadow="sm"><Stack gap={6}><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap"><Text fw={700} size="sm" truncate>{item.source.path}</Text><Badge size="sm" variant="filled" color={!item.lastSnapshot ? "gray" : (item.lastSnapshot?.stats?.errorCount ?? 0) > 0 ? "orange" : "green"}>{!item.lastSnapshot ? "KEIN SNAPSHOT" : (item.lastSnapshot?.stats?.errorCount ?? 0) > 0 ? (item.lastSnapshot.stats.errorCount + " Fehler") : "OK"}</Badge></Group><Group gap="xs"><Badge size="xs" variant="outline" color="gray" tt="none">{item.source.userName + "@" + item.source.host}</Badge><Badge size="xs" variant="light" color={item.status === "UPLOADING" ? "blue" : item.status === "FAILED" ? "red" : "gray"}>{item.status ?? "?"}</Badge></Group><Group justify="space-between"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">💾 Größe</Text><Text size="xs" fw={600}>{(item.lastSnapshot?.stats?.totalSize ?? 0) >= 1099511627776 ? ((item.lastSnapshot.stats.totalSize / 1099511627776).toFixed(2) + " TiB") : (((item.lastSnapshot?.stats?.totalSize ?? 0) / 1073741824).toFixed(1) + " GiB")}</Text></Group><Group justify="space-between"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">⏰ Zeitplan</Text><Text size="xs" fw={600}>{(item.schedule?.timeOfDay ?? []).length === 0 ? "manuell" : item.schedule.timeOfDay.map((t) => String(t.hour).padStart(2, "0") + ":" + String(t.min ?? 0).padStart(2, "0")).join(", ") + " Uhr"}</Text></Group><Group justify="space-between"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">🕒 Letzter</Text><Text size="xs" fw={600}>{item.lastSnapshot?.endTime ? (item.lastSnapshot.endTime.slice(8, 10) + "." + item.lastSnapshot.endTime.slice(5, 7) + "." + item.lastSnapshot.endTime.slice(0, 4) + ", " + item.lastSnapshot.endTime.slice(11, 16) + " UTC") : "nie"}</Text></Group><Group justify="space-between"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">⏭ Nächster</Text><Text size="xs" fw={600}>{item.nextSnapshotTime ?
